items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 64:1
items.html: The Mochin of SAG that AVI impart for the sake of Beriah are not from the discernment of the coupling of AVI in their place, that is, from the place of their standing in the HGT of AA; rather, they descend and unite with YESHSUT, who clothe them from the Chazeh downward of AA, and clothe in ZON. Then the Malchut of Ima touches the Parsa beneath Atzilut, and in this manner the Mochin of AVI are made, and the Mochin come out in the discernment of Hassadim separated from Hochma. And this coupling of AVI is called a coupling "of the lowering of the head", because the GAR are lowered and brought down to couple in the place of the NHY of AA, and in the discernment of the screen included in the Parsa and the conclusion of Atzilut. See above, answer 50. (Item 196).
